commands.name: Open a SQLite database
commands.description: Open or create a SQLite database in the interactive sqlite3 shell.

commands.name: List SQLite tables
commands.description: List tables in a SQLite database, including a Room database file.

commands.name: Show SQLite schema
commands.description: Print table and index creation statements from a SQLite database.

commands.name: Run a read-only SQLite query
commands.command: sqlite3 -readonly <database.db> "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';"
commands.description: Run a query in read-only mode to inspect a SQLite database.

commands.name: Back up a SQLite database
commands.description: Create a consistent SQLite database backup using the sqlite shell.

commands.name: Check SQLite database integrity
commands.description: Run SQLite’s integrity check against a database file.
